title: S150 19.1.6 Relating SIP URIs and tel URLs
parent_path: S150 19.1.6 Relating SIP URIs and tel URLs

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: To mitigate this problem, elements constructing telephone-subscriber fields to place in the userinfo part of a SIP or SIPS URI SHOULD fold any case-insensitive portion of telephone-subscriber to lower case, and order the telephone-subscriber parameters lexically by parameter name, excepting isdn-subaddress and post-dial, which occur first and in that order.
